### Added

- *(metatools)* Short tool descriptions led by a summary line, annotated, checked with tooldesc in [#1622](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1622) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(workflow)* Nested forEach, parallelism, paginate and jq in [#1626](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1626) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(orchestrator)* A started tenant or toolPrefix server no longer waits for a false registration timeout in [#1624](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1624) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)
